title_en: Lao Hu in the Back Seat
note_en: Comparison uses the pattern A + 比 + B + (更) + adjective: 它比我更守规矩 "it follows the rules better than I do." The adjective itself doesn't change form (English adds -er or "more"), and 更 just stresses the difference. The negative uses 没有: 它没有我熟悉这座城市 "it doesn't know this city as well as I do" (literally "doesn't have my familiarity").
